articles.title: Ex-Celsius CEO Mashinsky gets U.S. CFTC ban in final resolution with regulator
articles.snippet: Alexander Mashinsky, the founder of failed crypto lender Celsius, had earlier been imprisoned for fraud and is now formally banned from CFTC registration.

articles.title: U.S. agencies seek stablecoin customer-ID rules akin to banks in new GENIUS Act pitch
articles.snippet: The Federal Reserve, Treasury and other regulators have issued a proposed rule that would set identification standards, and it's now open for public comments.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Trading the bitcoin cycle
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s 4-year cycle makes DCA costly. Learn why a cycle-smart strategy is essential for advisors to better manage volatility and maximize client returns.

articles.title: Algorand unveils roadmap to achieve quantum resistance by 2028
articles.snippet: The announcement reflects a crypto's growing recognition that adopting quantum-resistant cryptography could take years, requiring changes not only to user wallets but also to core protocol infrastructure.

articles.title: Alchemy's AI-driven identity and payment service gains access to Visa network
articles.snippet: The AgentCard integration with Visa Intelligent Commerce allows AI agents built on models from any provider, including OpenAI or Anthropic, to effect commercial transactions.
